text:
Alex: hey team :wave: first day here. on an M2 mac, switched my shell to fish. trying to bootstrap dev env (asdf for python/node/rust, dotfiles). hitting an openssl build error when asdf tries to compile python 3.11. also ssh-agent seems not to auto-load keys in fish. 1Password CLI prompts for SSO and I don't have access to the company vault yet. who should I ping for VPN/okta/git access? any quick fish/asdf tips?

Priya: welcome Alex! :thumbsup: for openssl errors on arm macs, brew openssl is usually the fix. try this first: 
```
brew install openssl@1.1 readline sqlite3 xz zlib
set -x LDFLAGS "-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"
set -x CPPFLAGS "-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include"
# then in fish make sure asdf env is loaded and install
eval (asdf init - | source)
asdf install python 3.11.4
```
If you prefer to persist, add those set lines to ~/.config/fish/config.fish.

Priya: for asdf->node on mac you also need the nodejs plugin's gpg keys imported: 
```
# one-time for asdf nodejs plugin
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs/master/bin/import-release-team-keyring | bash
asdf plugin add nodejs https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs.git
asdf install nodejs 18.17.1
```

Marta: re: 1Password/SSO — ping me (Marta) and I'll invite you to the Redwood org vault. we use Okta, so you should get a one-time SSO link after I add you. once in 1P, run `op signin redwood` and then `eval (op signin --account redwood --output=env)` in fish.

Marta: also add your SSH public key to GitHub and our internal GitLab account. generate with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "your@work.email"` then `pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and paste into both profiles.

InfraOps: Hi Alex — for VPN/AD access we need your employee id and manager's email. Please open an internal IT ticket here: https://itsupport.redwood.internal/tickets/new and tag it `onboarding` and `vpn`. If you prefer, ping me here and I can fast-track it.

dev_onboard_bot: Automated checklist created for Alex — items: [create-ssh-key, add-to-1password, clone-dotfiles, install-asdf-runtimes, request-vpn, grant-git-access] (0/6).

Alex: just ran the brew + LDFLAGS trick — python 3.11 installed 🎉. node install still asking for gpg import, will run that. ssh-agent still not auto-loading after a reboot though.

Priya: for fish and ssh-agent, add this snippet to ~/.config/fish/config.fish: 
```
# start ssh-agent if not running
if test -z "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK"
    eval (ssh-agent -c) >/dev/null
    ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 >/dev/null ^&1; or true
end
```
That should keep it loaded for new shells. if you use macOS keychain, run `ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` once (legacy) or configure Keychain Access > Allow.

Priya: for rust on M-series just use rustup default stable — usually works. if cargo compilation errors pop up, `brew install llvm` and set `set -x CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_LINKER /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang` only needed for cross-compiling.

Alex: ran the ssh-agent snippet, works now. cloned dotfiles repo and ran bootstrap script: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/dotfiles.git && ./dotfiles/bootstrap.sh` — small tweak: bootstrap asks to symlink fish functions, so I gave it my ok.

Marta: awesome. once you're in 1P I'll share a secrets-sample file for local env vars (don't check it in). we recommend putting dev-only secrets in `~/.redwood/env.local` and ignoring it in git.

InfraOps: ticket #ONB-482 created and assigned to infra for VPN; ETA for access is ~2 business days unless we fast-track. Alex, you should get Okta invite email in a few minutes.

Alex: got the Okta invite, signed in, 1Password access granted. big thanks everyone! :raised_hands: will follow up if anything else pops up.

Priya: great! tag @Priya if you hit CI/container quirks. also check `docs/onboarding/dev-setup.md` in the handbook — it has mac/linux snippets and container devcontainer tips.

Alex: one more small question — are we expected to use the company devcontainer or local docker? I'm leaning devcontainer for consistent env.

Marta: use devcontainer by default for services that have them. if something is flaky, we pair on it. welcome again!

Alex: thanks all :heart:
